env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_PCIE_CUSTOM_AR

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_P1_PREFILL

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_EXTEND_WARPS8

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_SPLITK_FUSED_REDUCE

Graph-captured and DRAM-fed on gfx1201 (16 layers on separate KV caches): 96.6 / 178 / 321 / 434 against 114.5 / 219 / 406 / 560 us per layer at 23.5K / 47K / 88K / 120K prefixes, 1.3 us slower at 1K. Not bitwise equal (online-softmax steps change); the error against an FP32 reference is unchanged, so it must pass the bench quality phase.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_MXFP4_KQ3
env.reason: MXFP4 GEMMs of at most 16 rows on the split-K shards run kq3, a Gluon kernel over pre-packed weight records (WMMA fragment order, register SWAR decode, K partitions reduced in the workgroup in the fixed order), bitwise equal to the split-K + fused-reduce path: 2,048 of 2,048 real-checkpoint outputs (64 layers, both ranks, five shapes, 8/16 rows) and 1,104 of 1,104 through the patched layers. A graph walking every layer's real weights took 12.08 / 12.10 ms of GEMM per verify round against 18.66 / 18.46 ms. The records replace the weight (+33 MB); prefill rebuilds it into a per-card scratch, about 26 ms per forward.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_P1_FROM_KQ3
env.reason: The P1 prefill route expands its block-FP8 weight directly from kq3 records instead of rebuilding the canonical MXFP4 weight first; bitwise equal (30 of 30 expansion cases, 104 of 104 GEMM outputs on vs off; proved per layer at load). One card's 304-linear stack saved 27.5 / 26.6 / 27.2 ms per prefill forward at 1024 / 1536 / 2048 rows.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_PCIE_CUSTOM_AR_MAX_BYTES
env.reason: Prefill-chunk reductions (up to 2048 x 5120 BF16 = 20 MiB) take the PCIe custom all-reduce instead of RCCL; 0025 grows its IPC buffer to this 24 MiB cap. 66 against 76 ms of all-reduce per 2048-row chunk and 3.8 against 8.4 ms per short-prompt forward; bitwise equal to RCCL (0 mismatches in 4,800 reductions, 51-2048 rows).

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_FP8_KV_DEQUANT
env.reason: UQ2 (patches 0026 + 0027): read the fp8 target and draft KV caches as bf16 in the extend, grouped decode and verify kernels, keeping q and p in bf16, and let the verify kernel take fp8 caches; 0027 decodes with v_cvt_f32_fp8 (bitwise equal to the Triton cast). Serving quality unmeasured.

env.name: ROCPROFILER_REGISTER_ENABLED
env.reason: Measured 2026-11-11 (rocm_sdk 10.3.0.dev20261108): with the profiler SDK registered as an HSA tool, HIP's start-up uses up the process's ~4096 KFD events, every later interrupt signal gets none, and ROCr's async-event and signal-wait loops spin a core each (5 threads at 100% with SGLang idle). Off: idle CPU 0%, GPU wait latency unchanged. Set it to 1 for a torch.profiler or rocprofv3 session.
env.source: rocr-runtime core/runtime/runtime.cpp AsyncEventsLoop, interrupt_signal.cpp; dev-pod probes 2026-11-11

toolchain_env.reason: Triton and SGLang JIT need the TheRock SDK inside the image; op234 bound LLVM_PATH to the SDK's LLVM after its sandbox dropped it.
toolchain_env.source: op234 launch environment; serving repository docs/BUILD.md

must_unset_env.name: HSA_ENABLE_SDMA
must_unset_env.reason: SDMA-off is a separate diagnostic profile.

must_unset_env.name: SGLANG_DISABLE_DRAFT_EXTEND_CUDA_GRAPH
must_unset_env.reason: op234 setting; no effect on the DFLASH v2 worker.

must_unset_env.name: ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT
must_unset_env.reason: op234 set the undocumented value -1; unset gives the same backend on gfx1201.

not_set.reason: One 262144-token pool copy is about 16 GiB of pinned host memory on a 62 GiB host without swap; the NAS is too slow for an L3 tier.
Startup cost and HIP dynamic-shape gating with no measured benefit.
